nodes.label: Frame 03901 - Overhead Broiler House CCTV, Siren Camera, 2022-03-01 23:03:23
nodes.description: Top-down colour CCTV still of a commercial broiler house floor, camera label '1080P-IPC-Siren', burned-in timestamp 2022-03-01 23:03:23. Near-market-weight white broilers densely cover the litter floor. A horizontal grey feed conveyor pipe crosses the frame carrying five red-topped circular pan feeders; birds form radial rosettes around each pan. A dark winch/tension cable arcs across the lower third. Barrel distortion from a wide-angle lens is visible.

nodes.label: Siren Camera Viewpoint (1080P-IPC-Siren)
nodes.description: Named fixed overhead IP camera whose watermark '1080P-IPC-Siren' appears on frames 03901, 04101, 04901, 05101 and 05601. Defines one recording station/pen in the broiler house.
nodes.rationale: A per-camera watermark plus burned-in timestamp lets frames be grouped back into recording sessions and pens after they have been flattened into a single img_test folder, which is why the overlay is retained rather than cropped out.

nodes.label: Suspended Pan Feeder Line
nodes.description: Horizontal feed conveyor pipe carrying evenly spaced circular pan feeders with red control caps, running across every frame in this chunk. The dominant fixed landmark of the scene.
nodes.rationale: Because the feeder line is static across all frames and cameras, it acts as a natural spatial reference/anchor for registering frames and for defining a feeding zone region-of-interest.

nodes.label: Feeding Cluster (Radial Rosette at Pan Feeder)
nodes.description: Recurrent behavioural pattern in which birds arrange themselves head-in around a pan feeder, producing a radial rosette/flower shape from overhead. Visible at every pan in frames 03901, 04101, 05101, 05401 and weakly in the IR night frames.
nodes.rationale: The rosette is the visual signature the analysis pipeline can key on to score feeding activity without individual tracking - counting birds inside a feeder radius is far more robust than classifying posture in a top-down, heavily occluded view.

nodes.label: Burned-In Timestamp and Camera Label Overlay
nodes.description: DVR overlay printing the camera name at top-left and 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' at top-right of every frame. Supplies the only per-frame temporal and source metadata, since filenames carry just a sequence number.

nodes.label: Overhead Wide-Angle (Fisheye-Distorted) Viewpoint
nodes.description: All frames are ceiling-mounted top-down views with visible barrel distortion - straight structures such as the feed pipe and floor cable bow across the frame, and birds near the edges are foreshortened.

nodes.label: img_test Held-Out Evaluation Frame Set
nodes.description: The img_test directory these frames belong to: sparsely sampled stills (frame03901, 04101, 04901, 05101, 05401, 05601 - roughly every 200-800 frames) drawn from multiple cameras, dates, lighting modes and bird ages.
nodes.rationale: Wide stride between sampled frame numbers avoids near-duplicate leakage between train and test, while deliberately mixing cameras, day/night and growth stages keeps the evaluation set representative of deployment conditions.
